name: icon-cloud
title: Icon Cloud
description: An interactive 3D sphere of icons or images that rotates with the pointer; click an icon to bring it to the front.
usage:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { IconCloud } from '@/components/ui/icon-cloud'

const images = ['vuedotjs', 'nuxt', 'vite', 'typescript'].map(
  (slug) => `https://cdn.simpleicons.org/${slug}/${slug}`,
)
</script>

<template>
  <IconCloud :images="images" />
</template>

props.name: icons
props.description: Icons to place on the sphere: SVG markup strings, components (e.g. Lucide icons) or vnodes from h(). They are rasterised once, so currentColor renders black; pass explicit colours.

props.name: images
props.description: Image URLs to place on the sphere, cropped to circles. Used when icons is not set. The images are requested with crossOrigin="anonymous".

props.name: showControl
props.description: Show the play / pause button (WCAG 2.2.2). Rotation also pauses under reduced motion.
